NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ℹ️  | The "not ready" label had no written feedback, so there is no list of requests to check. |
| ❌  | No linked issue. The description has no "Fixes: #N", so we can't check that the issue is labeled "help wanted". |
| ✅  | Test added, and the description says how it was tested. |
| ✅  | Screenshots are not needed (backend only), and the self-review checklist is filled in. |
| ✅  | The 5 new pushes were squashed into one commit, and CI passes. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link the issue this fixes. If there is none, or it isn't "help wanted", this becomes a close candidate.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @Prajvalkumar24! Please add the issue this fixes as "Fixes: #N" in the description (it needs to be labeled "help wanted"). Please also leave the "not ready" label to the maintainers; we'll change it once that is sorted out.
```
